findings.title: Tracker rejection feedback and bounded recovery are missing
findings.demonstrated: Rejected patches roll back, but the next input lacks the rejection and persistent failures consume all six stage calls.
findings.proposed_only: Precise validation feedback and a bounded recovery path preserving atomic guards.

findings.title: Private work conclusions are not transported across role calls
findings.demonstrated: Fresh two-message inputs omit previous private work prose. An actual save_notes control transports the same conclusion and permits publication.
findings.proposed_only: Explicit versioned work results with sources and acknowledgment by chat.

findings.title: A correct private answer can remain undelivered
findings.demonstrated: The original multiple-owner unified repeat 2 states the correct arrival window in all six final private answers but never calls publish_card.
findings.proposed_only: Record computed and delivered states separately and evaluate the actual display.

findings.title: Publication guards do not enforce answer coverage or scope
findings.demonstrated: Scripted incomplete, wrong-choice and out-of-scope drafts were displayed; blank and stale-observation controls were rejected.
findings.proposed_only: Test coverage against the current request without treating citation validity or freshness as semantic correctness.

architecture_proposal.work_result: Explicit source-linked result tied to the current intention version
architecture_proposal.completion_state: Distinguish computed content from delivered content

limitations: No new real model inference, repair, training, LoRA, default Lab change or new model-quality comparison.
Scripted callbacks are deterministic test doubles. Their usage values are synthetic and are not measured inference tokens or costs.
Original labels are reused; trace string presence is not semantic rescoring. Full source and raw request availability does not establish attention or comprehension.
The original pilot has eight authored families with correlated repeats, not 48 independent users.
The three failed desired capabilities are diagnostic expectations, distinct from the current documented fail-closed and private-prose contracts.
Semantic errors being accepted by a current publication guard are not quality passes.
The native optional AnswerDelivery node exists but is not used by this experimental IntentRoleSession path; its ability to repair these cases was not tested.
Workshop price is explicit in the raw user request only in stage 3; earlier gold wording is not treated as an earlier user requirement.
Observed gaps do not establish the causal quality benefit of any proposed fix. No ASR, live-user or long-conversation benefit was evaluated.
Client model captures do not inspect raw HTTP or model-server internals.
